provenance_events.description: Rolex releases the 126500LN at Watches and Wonders 2023 — same 40mm case but a redesigned bezel, new indices, and the calibre 4131 (a 4130 derivative with a thinner chronometer escapement). The new model is the Daytona baseline from 2023 onward.

Rolex releases the 126500LN at Watches and Wonders 2023 — same 40mm case but a redesigned bezel, new indices, and the calibre 4131 (a 4130 derivative with a thinner chronometer escapement). The new model is the Daytona baseline from 2023 onward. Hong Kong ADs form a multi-year waitlist on the 126500LN through 2023-2024.

narrative.story: Introduced at Watches and Wonders 2023 for the Daytona's 60th anniversary, the 126500LN reworked the case lines and framed the Cerachrom bezel with a thin polished-steel edge. Inside, the 4131 replaced the long-serving 4130, adding the Chronergy escapement and a redesigned rotor. The white dial kept its predecessor's market pattern: it is the harder allocation and the stronger trader of the two dials.
narrative.collector_notes: Differences from the 116500LN are subtle at a glance — the steel bezel lip, slimmer lugs, and reworked subdial rings. White dials command the premium; grey-market spreads narrowed from the 2022 peak but stay above retail.
